description: Replay a previously saved Devicely recording across target device(s). Executes commands sequentially or with independent device lanes with progress reporting.

autoWaitTimeoutMs.description: Auto-wait timeout per step in milliseconds (default 10000)

anyOf.description: Target device name, serial, UDID, or selector ("all", "online", "commander", "followers")
Array of target device names, serials, or UDIDs

name.description: Recording to replay: its filename (with or without .json) or the name it was saved under (newest wins if several share it)

retries.description: Number of retry attempts per failed step (default 1)

name: devicely_replay_recording
